In summary, our research is concerned with
the ways in which expert systems that inform vaccination programs can be perceived as a threat to children and their families.
the ways in which vaccine rejecters perceive the expert systems that drive vaccination programs, and how this perception influences their engagement with these systems.
the ways in which distrust is generated in the expert systems that underpin immunization programs.

vaccine rejection is a multifaceted phenomenon that is informed by a range of factors, including distrust in expert systems that inform immunization programs.

vaccine rejection is an expression of distrust of expert systems.
